observations: Photo 0 shows two donut-shaped automatic transmission torque converters sitting on a wooden plank/workbench.
Background shows part of an open transmission case or oil pan, consistent with a gearbox teardown shop setting.
A partial alphanumeric code is stamped on the right-hand converter's housing, but it is not fully legible due to lighting and angle.
Both converters show oil/grime staining typical of used, removed parts.
No Toyota logo, OEM part sticker, or clearly readable part number is visible on either converter.
Image has overlay watermarks 'DE EKESON MOTORS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.claim: Converter is for Toyota Corolla gearbox
claims.evidence: No Toyota branding or matching OEM part number legible in photo 0 to confirm vehicle fitment.
No functional test, bench spin, or internal inspection shown; grading is a subjective seller claim with no supporting visual proof.

risks.risk: Internal wear or failure (stator one-way clutch, lock-up clutch, bushings) cannot be assessed from an external photo.
risks.proof: A video of the converter being spun by hand showing one-way clutch lock in one direction and free rotation in the other, or a bench test result.

risks.risk: Exact vehicle/engine/transmission fitment to a specific Corolla generation is unconfirmed.
risks.proof: A clear, well-lit close-up of the stamped part number cross-checked against Toyota OEM catalog.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unverified-fit used converter

risks.risk: Hidden mechanical damage (dents, spline wear, cracked hub) could be obscured by grime.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of cleaned hub splines and converter housing from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: priced as-is with unknown hidden damage

risks.risk: The two converters shown may not be a matched pair or may be for different models despite being sold together.
risks.proof: Individual clear photos of each unit's stamped number for comparison.

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit close-up of the full stamped part number on each converter.
Video of each converter being manually rotated to check one-way clutch and smoothness.
Any paperwork or photo showing the donor vehicle (VIN plate, engine bay) confirming Corolla origin.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as used automatic transmission torque converters, but Corolla-specific fitment and functional condition are unverified from the photo, so it must be priced at worst case pending proof.
